description: A complete Major League game from Retrosheet (game SDN201905080): New York Mets at San Diego Padres, 2019-05-08, final New York Mets 2, San Diego Padres 3. Every pitch and play, converted by retrosheet/convert.py; the expected stats are the official box score. No designated hitter: pitchers bat, with pinch hitters for pitchers and a double switch by each team. The Padres lead after the top of the ninth and do not bat in it. The Mets' fifth-inning double play is a strikeout and a pickoff on the same pitch (Retrosheet K+PO1(23)/DP): the strike-three pitch and then the pickoff, marked as completing a double play with the strikeout.
